title: Quick Wire Connectors Inline Splice – 50-Pack for All Circuits
descriptionHtml:
Tangles and loose connections when splicing cables?

Twisting cables together, taping them up and hoping for a good connection often ends with loose contacts, short circuits or a soldering iron you can't be bothered to get out. And a bad splice can cause real trouble in the car or at home.

A secure splice in seconds

Insert the cables, press down the lever – done. The connectors give a stable, insulated connection without soldering or stripping. Perfect for cars, motorhomes, boats and home electronics, for different cable thicknesses (AWG 20–40).

Features

  • Snap-in function – secure splice without a soldering iron.
  • 50 connectors – enough for many projects.
  • Insulated connection – no loose contacts, no short circuits.
  • For AWG 20–40 – fits most cables.

Changing your mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
